hook.text_top: They laughed at the quiet girl.
hook.voice: They laughed at the quiet girl. Then this happened.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance two point five.

shots.excerpt: Close-up of the girl, front-on, locked-off with a very slow push-in. She raises her eyes straight into the lens. At the very end, a faint cold half-smile.
shots.voice: Shot two. A close-up with a very slow push-in. She raises her eyes into the lens, and ends on a cold half-smile.

shots.excerpt: Handheld wider shot facing the front of the room: she spins away from a falling boy and lands in a fighting stance. Boys jump up and rush toward her.
shots.voice: Shot five. Handheld and wider. She spins away, lands in a fighting stance, and the whole class rushes her.

shots.excerpt: Low-angle handheld close to the floor: a boy lunges, she drops low under his arms and flips him over her back. Loose white papers scatter.
shots.voice: Shot nine. Low angle, right on the floor. She drops under his arms and flips him over her back.

shots.excerpt: Locked-off wide shot: the boy flies over the wooden lectern and crashes behind it. Dozens of white papers burst into the air and slowly flutter down.
shots.voice: Shot fifteen. A locked-off wide shot. He crashes behind the lectern, and dozens of papers burst into the air.

shots.excerpt: Close-up of her face, warm light, dust specks floating. She raises her eyes straight into the lens with a cold, satisfied half-smile. Slow push-in.
shots.voice: And the final shot. A close-up, a slow push-in, and that same cold half-smile, straight into the lens.
